items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I am the leader. But now I'm gone so now the Clarence player is the leader... There's no musical leader at all.

ctx.x: I am the leader. But now I'm gone so now the Clarence player is the leader. It's not really... It's a leader. It's not really a leader in the band. Just everybody is a leader. The leader... The only thing with the leader is that he gets the jobs and pays the musics. That's the only... There's no musical leader at all. There's nobody saying now we play this tune.
Well who's in your band? What are the names of the people?
